set.body: Root eco-u4-measurements. Move generic spatial frame/support/scatter and integer volume graph from ScalaFIM 694c711c9 into optional mvpa4s-locus. Preserve persisted IDs, support manifests, scientific values, runtime/type owner refusals, local failure visibility and resource contracts. No surface/image/neuroim dependency or forwarding facades. Acceptance: frozen pre-move identity literals; portable owner/order/scatter/volume-graph cases JVM+JS; actual downstream volume/surface/predictive composition and independent review.
set.title: Extract optional locus measurement and scatter adapters
